items.t: No SkyTrain, West Coast Express or SeaBus station is in Chilliwack. Route 66 Fraser Valley Express (BC Transit) runs Downtown Chilliwack to Lougheed Town Centre Station, the nearest rapid-transit station.
Nearest bus exchange: Downtown Exchange, Chilliwack.
Route 57 Broadway (BC Transit): Downtown Chilliwack to Cottonwood Mall via Young Rd and Yale Rd at Menzies St, at the west base of the hill.
Little Mountain Park: loop trail connecting Chartwell Drive to Swallow Crescent and Hillcrest Drive, with picnic tables, playground and view platform.
Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre, 9145 Corbould St.
Little Mountain Elementary, K-5, School District 33 Chilliwack, 9900 Carleton St; catchment not confirmed.

Official boundary: the City of Chilliwack publishes no boundary for the Little Mountain name.

faq.q: Is Little Mountain the same as Chilliwack Mountain?
faq.a: No. Little Mountain is the smaller hillside immediately east of downtown Chilliwack, anchored by Little Mountain Elementary (9900 Carleton Street); Chilliwack Mountain is a separate hillside community on the south side of the Fraser River, west of the downtown core.

Little Mountain Elementary (K–5) at 9900 Carleton Street is on the hill, with Strathcona Elementary (K–5), Chilliwack Middle School (6–8) and Chilliwack Secondary (9–12) at or below its west base; catchments are address-specific — check any address in the SD33 School Locator.

faq.q: What hillside rules apply to building or subdividing here?
faq.a: Development Permit Area 2 (Hillside and Upland) requires a Geotechnical Report from a qualified professional with each application, and Development Permit Area 5 applies to all City lands with slopes of 20% or more; a Development Permit is required before subdivision, construction or land alteration in a designated area, except where exemptions apply.

The zones set the floor, not the market: HR (Hillside Residential) requires at least 0.2 ha with community water (0.4 ha otherwise) and 25 m width, while SHR (Suburban Hillside Residential) runs on a slope table from 360 m² to 990 m².

faq.q: Is there bus service on Little Mountain?
faq.a: The confirmed service is at the base: BC Transit route 57 Broadway runs between Downtown Chilliwack and Cottonwood Mall via Yale Road at Menzies Street and Young Road at Olds Drive; no stop on the hill's residential streets was confirmed.
